trigger.authentication_note: Google Calendar connection 'Google Calendar dennis@work.flowers'. The Google credential lives HERE, on the trigger — the workflow never calls Google back, so it is not in --connections.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger. `expand_recurring: false` matches the classic Zap it replaces: a single-occurrence edit (the common case, and the one that was failing) arrives with its own occurrence id, while a whole-series edit arrives as the master event and matches no note. See the README's 'What it deliberately does not do'.

tables.01JZCVG73MBWWB0357CEPS4903: [Table] Meeting Note IDs — read for the page lookup, written back to keep Start/End/iCal UID current. Owned by the meeting-note-db-updates Notion Worker.

replaces_classic_zap: Updated Meeting -> Update Meeting Note in Notion
description: Google Calendar event updated -> update the Date on its Notion meeting note. Looks the page up in [Table] Meeting Note IDs on the per-occurrence Google event id; update-only, never creates.
